news.title: Cold case breakthrough: DNA links man to 4 crimes, investigators say
news.summary: A cold case investigation has connected a Tucker man to four crimes dating back to 2014, including two sexual assaults, a kidnapping and a deadly stabbing, according to DeKalb County investigators.

news.title: Teen killed after e-scooter crashes with tractor-trailer in Marietta
news.summary: A 17-year-old was killed after a crash involving an e-scooter and a tractor-trailer in Marietta on Friday afternoon, according to the Marietta Police Department.

news.title: ‘Just call it evil’: Serial rapist pleads guilty 40 years after crimes
